question: Compare prognostic genes in the HPA TCGA Kidney Renal Clear Cell Carcinoma and Lung Adenocarcinoma cohorts, including both potential and validated prognostic associations and excluding unprognostic fields. Give favourable and unfavourable gene counts for each, same-direction and opposite-direction overlap counts, and the number of genes prognostic in both that are FDA approved drug targets or secreted to blood. Among genes favourable in both, rank twelve by the larger of their two favourable prognostic p-values, smallest first, ties by Ensembl ID. Give both p-values, the evidence categories, kidney and lung consensus nTPM and protein classes. Draw direction-overlap bars, a two-cancer p-value scatter and an RNA heatmap; provide the tables. If a requested ranked list has fewer eligible members, return every eligible member and state the count. Use Ensembl genes present in the HPA master table as the gene universe and break all gene-ranking ties by Ensembl ID.

{"query":"SELECT

FROM cancer_prognostic_data
WHERE Cancer IN ('Kidney Renal Clear Cell Carcinoma (TCGA)', 'Lung Adenocarcinoma (TCGA)')

{"query":"WITH k AS (
  SELECT 
    Gene,
    CASE 
      WHEN "potential prognostic - favorable" != '' OR "validated prognostic - favorable" != '' THEN 'favorable'
      WHEN "potential prognostic - unfavorable" != '' OR "validated prognostic - unfavorable" != '' THEN 'unfavorable'
      ELSE NULL 
    END AS k_dir
  FROM cancer_prognostic_data
  WHERE Cancer = 'Kidney Renal Clear Cell Carcinoma (TCGA)'
),
l AS (
  SELECT 
    Gene,
    CASE 
      WHEN "potential prognostic - favorable" != '' OR "validated prognostic - favorable" != '' THEN 'favorable'
      WHEN "potential prognostic - unfavorable" != '' OR "validated prognostic - unfavorable" != '' THEN 'unfavorable'
      ELSE NULL 
    END AS l_dir
  FROM cancer_prognostic_data
  WHERE Cancer = 'Lung Adenocarcinoma (TCGA)'
)
SELECT 
  k.k_dir,
  l.l_dir,
  COUNT(*) as count
FROM k
JOIN l ON k.Gene = l.Gene
WHERE k.k_dir IS NOT NULL AND l.l_dir IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY k.k_dir, l.l_dir;"}

{"query":"SELECT 
  count(*) as total_prog_both,
  sum(case when p."Protein class" LIKE '%FDA approved drug targets%' then 1 else 0 end) as fda_targets,
  sum(case when p."Secretome location" = 'Secreted to blood' then 1 else 0 end) as sec_blood,
  sum(case when p."Protein class" LIKE '%FDA approved drug targets%' OR p."Secretome location" = 'Secreted to blood' then 1 else 0 end) as either,
  sum(case when p."Protein class" LIKE '%FDA approved drug targets%' AND p."Secretome location" = 'Secreted to blood' then 1 else 0 end) as both_criteria
FROM cancer_prognostic_data k
JOIN cancer_prognostic_data l ON k.Gene = l.Gene
JOIN proteinatlas p ON k.Gene = p.Ensembl
WHERE k.Cancer = 'Kidney Renal Clear Cell Carcinoma (TCGA)'
  AND l.Cancer = 'Lung Adenocarcinoma (TCGA)'
  AND (k."potential prognostic - favorable" != '' OR k."validated prognostic - favorable" != '' OR k."potential prognostic - unfavorable" != '' OR k."validated prognostic - unfavorable" != '')

{"query":"WITH k AS (
  SELECT 
    Gene,
    Gene_name,
    COALESCE(NULLIF("potential prognostic - favorable", ''), NULLIF("validated prognostic - favorable", '')) AS p_val_k,
    CASE 
      WHEN "validated prognostic - favorable" != '' THEN 'validated prognostic favorable'
      WHEN "potential prognostic - favorable" != '' THEN 'potential prognostic favorable'
    END AS evidence_k
  FROM cancer_prognostic_data
  WHERE Cancer = 'Kidney Renal Clear Cell Carcinoma (TCGA)'
    AND ("potential prognostic - favorable" != '' OR "validated prognostic - favorable" != '')
),
l AS (
  SELECT 
    Gene,
    COALESCE(NULLIF("potential prognostic - favorable", ''), NULLIF("validated prognostic - favorable", '')) AS p_val_l,
    CASE 
      WHEN "validated prognostic - favorable" != '' THEN 'validated prognostic favorable'
      WHEN "potential prognostic - favorable" != '' THEN 'potential prognostic favorable'
    END AS evidence_l
  FROM cancer_prognostic_data
  WHERE Cancer = 'Lung Adenocarcinoma (TCGA)'
    AND ("potential prognostic - favorable" != '' OR "validated prognostic - favorable" != '')
)
SELECT 
  k.Gene,
  k.Gene_name,
  TRY_CAST(k.p_val_k AS DOUBLE) AS p_k,
  TRY_CAST(l.p_val_l AS DOUBLE) AS p_l,
  GREATEST(TRY_CAST(k.p_val_k AS DOUBLE), TRY_CAST(l.p_val_l AS DOUBLE)) AS max_p,
  k.evidence_k,
  l.evidence_l
FROM k
JOIN l ON k.Gene = l.Gene
ORDER BY max_p ASC, k.Gene ASC
LIMIT 15;"}

{"query":"WITH top12 AS (
  WITH k AS (
    SELECT 
      Gene,
      "Gene name" AS gene_name,
      COALESCE(NULLIF("potential prognostic - favorable", ''), NULLIF("validated prognostic - favorable", '')) AS p_val_k,
      CASE 
        WHEN "validated prognostic - favorable" != '' THEN 'validated prognostic favorable'
        WHEN "potential prognostic - favorable" != '' THEN 'potential prognostic favorable'
      END AS evidence_k
    FROM cancer_prognostic_data
    WHERE Cancer = 'Kidney Renal Clear Cell Carcinoma (TCGA)'
      AND ("potential prognostic - favorable" != '' OR "validated prognostic - favorable" != '')
  ),
  l AS (
    SELECT 
      Gene,
      COALESCE(NULLIF("potential prognostic - favorable", ''), NULLIF("validated prognostic - favorable", '')) AS p_val_l,
      CASE 
        WHEN "validated prognostic - favorable" != '' THEN 'validated prognostic favorable'
        WHEN "potential prognostic - favorable" != '' THEN 'potential prognostic favorable'
      END AS evidence_l
    FROM cancer_prognostic_data
    WHERE Cancer = 'Lung Adenocarcinoma (TCGA)'
      AND ("potential prognostic - favorable" != '' OR "validated prognostic - favorable" != '')
  )
  SELECT 
    k.Gene,
    k.gene_name,
    k.p_val_k,
    k.evidence_k,
    l.p_val_l,
    l.evidence_l,
    TRY_CAST(k.p_val_k AS DOUBLE) AS p_k,
    TRY_CAST(l.p_val_l AS DOUBLE) AS p_l,
    GREATEST(TRY_CAST(k.p_val_k AS DOUBLE), TRY_CAST(l.p_val_l AS DOUBLE)) AS max_p
  FROM k
  JOIN l ON k.Gene = l.Gene
  ORDER BY max_p ASC, k.Gene ASC
  LIMIT 12
)
SELECT 
  t.Gene,
  t.gene_name,
  t.p_val_k,
  t.evidence_k,
  t.p_val_l,
  t.evidence_l,
  t.max_p,
  p.Evidence AS protein_evidence,
  p."Protein class",
  rk.nTPM AS kidney_ntpm,
  rl.nTPM AS lung_ntpm
FROM top12 t
JOIN proteinatlas p ON t.Gene = p.Ensembl
LEFT JOIN rna_tissue_consensus rk ON t.Gene = rk.Gene AND rk.Tissue = 'kidney'
LEFT JOIN rna_tissue_consensus rl ON t.Gene = rl.Gene AND rl.Tissue = 'lung'
ORDER BY t.max_p ASC, t.Gene ASC;"}
